ideas.title: Follow the Money: Uncovering the Truth Behind the Federal Reserve Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the criminal investigation into Federal Reserve Chair Jerome Powell and the potential impact on the economy
questions: What are the allegations against Jerome Powell?
How will the investigation affect the economy?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale scandal and shed light on the inner workings of the Federal Reserve. I recommend using public records and interviewing sources to get to the bottom of the story.
